versions.content: The TcpIp shall report the runtime error by calling Det_ReportRuntimeError(TCPIP_E_TIMEDOUT) if one of the following conditions applies: (a) TcpIp mo dule has sent a SYN to establish a connection but did not receive any response. (b) An established idle TCP connection is closed because the peer is no longer present, i.e. keep - alive timer runs out and peer does not respond to keep - alive probes according to I ETF RFC 1122 chapter 4.2.3.6 TCP Keep - Alives. (c) An established TCP connection is closed because the peer does not respond, i.e. the maximum number of retransmissions has been sent without acknowledgement, according to [SWS_TCPIP_00202] .
